summary: Added the ratelimit stage (stages/ratelimit.py, ratelimit/address.py) and put it in STAGES between auth and upstream; fixed the existing code: Bucket.refill used float division, per accepted non-ASCII digits, and trusted/exempt networks accepted netmask forms. The unit tests pass and a replay of the shipped config over all traces runs; I checked the client address walk by hand, but there are no tests for the stage's edge cases beyond the existing ones.
